sources.note: 2027 Nelson Mandela call text: scholarships only for master's programmes of Annex 1; priority themes; Annex 1 is not attached

sources.publisher: Agencia Chilena de Cooperacion Internacional para el Desarrollo (AGCID)
sources.note: Programme page: master's programmes must be on the annexed list; MBAs and medical specialisations are not funded

subject_rule: Limited to the master's (magister) programmes on the call's Annex 1 list of accredited programmes (the call says scholarships can only be given for the master's studies Annex 1 refers to); the AGCID page adds that MBAs and medical specialisations are not funded, and priority goes to themes such as astronomy, mining, Antarctic sciences, renewable energy, marine resources, economic development, international trade, international relations, sovereignty and national security, and the fight against organised crime and terrorism.
notes: No programmes recorded: the Annex 1 list could not be read (see fetch problems).

The call lists candidacies within Annex 1 as a priority criterion and also says scholarships can only be given for the master's studies Annex 1 refers to; the programme page says the master's must be on the annexed list. Treat the list as a requirement.
Master's programmes in Chile are taught in Spanish.
not_stated: The Annex 1 programmes in any document that could be read
fetch_problems: Annex 1 (list of accredited master's programmes of the call) is named in the call but is not attached to the call PDF read (the PDF ends with the list of annex titles), and no separate Annex 1 file for 2027 is linked from the AGCID scholarship pages, so the programme list could not be read.
The AGCID web folder that holds the call files returns forbidden when its directory is opened; no file names were guessed.
